howto.name: Upload your PDF
howto.text: Drop a PDF up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Choose pages-per-sheet
howto.text: 2, 4, 6, 8, 9, or 16. Each input page is shrunk to fit; output pages are filled left-to-right, top-to-bottom.

howto.name: Download the n-up PDF
howto.text: Use this to save paper when printing or to create thumbnail-style overviews.

faq.a: Print-industry terminology: '2-up' = 2 pages per sheet, '4-up' = 4 per sheet, etc. Saves paper and ink for review prints.
Original page numbers (rendered on the page) shrink with the page. Add new page numbers afterwards if you need them readable.
2-up and 8-up work well for landscape, 4-up and 9-up for portrait. Mismatches add whitespace around each sub-page.
